purpose: Keep the existing public rating unchanged while correcting source metadata and reviewing actual consequences. This is an archival reproduction, not a renewed scientific approval.

frozenMetricContract.metric_name: Glacier-derived runoff share of seasonal water supply
frozenMetricContract.unit: percent and million cubic metres per season
frozenMetricContract.geography: declared basin, aquifer, utility, catchment, floodplain, or administrative reporting area
frozenMetricContract.cadence: event-based to monthly with annual accounting
frozenMetricContract.transformation: Preserve water-balance boundary, source and use sector, denominator, event definition, reporting coverage, and model version; keep observed, modeled, permitted, and estimated quantities distinct.
frozenMetricContract.uncertainty: Gauge and well coverage, withdrawals, return flows, groundwater-surface-water exchange, infrastructure reporting, model resolution, and revisions affect estimates.
frozenMetricContract.threshold_provenance: Use the responsible agency standard or a fixed basin-specific hydrologic threshold with versioned provenance.
frozenMetricContract.failure_behavior: Do not infer zero flow, zero withdrawal, or zero impact from missing observations or transfer basin results to individual assets.

records.correction: The live metric now correctly identifies WMO/UNESCO as context-only, not a glacier-only runoff-share measurement.
records.remainingReview: Dependence cannot substitute for current attributable harm. The existing central and lower components have not passed replacement consequence review.
records.limitation: All public assessment fields are pinned to their prior contents. Any further input, policy, candidate or output change fails the build; no automatic refresh or promotion is permitted.
